sections.content: To politely ask for food or drink, use 'Kérek' followed by the thing you want in accusative case (with -t suffix).

items.english: I request water, coffee and tea.

items.spanish: Kérek egy üveg vizet és egy pohár teát.
items.english: I request one bottle of water and one glass of tea.

sections.content: In a list, all items must take the accusative -t suffix: vizet, kávét, teát (water-ACC, coffee-ACC, tea-ACC).
